detected_fault: Thermal Throttling, BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) due to overheating during gaming sessions
suggested_solution: Portability: ITX cases and mATX cases for a more portable option.
Good Battery Life: Lenovo Y series laptops with GTX 800M series GPUs offer good value for their price.
Good Cooling: Look for laptops with advanced cooling systems, such as dual fans or liquid cooling.
Gaming Performance: Consider laptops with NVIDIA cards, such as the MSI G series, which offers high-performance gaming capabilities.
